source_context.summary: Trial 4 multi-submission evolution pressure test against the admitted Trial-3 canonical baseline.

records.statement: The Trial-2 non-no-op admission transaction passed the defined deterministic admission proof.
Trial 3's guarded admission transaction v2 passed with an exact before-state lifecycle update to a reused canonical unresolved-item record while preserving record identity and kind.
Trial 3 installed the exact persisted v2 proof candidate as canonical PEMS/2 and COVE state and preserved unrelated repository tree content.
Whether the standing RGP Admission Proof workflow preserves its guarantees for a novel non-no-op admission transaction remains unverified.
Whether guarded admission transaction v2 preserves its guarantees when one connected admission updates multiple reused canonical records remains unverified.
RGP admission has demonstrated multi-generation canonical evolution across both additive non-no-op admission and a guarded reused-record lifecycle transition.
The successful Trial-3 v2 proof establishes that guarded admission updates are correct for any number of reused-record updates in every future admission transaction.
